limitations: Only three nodes and one held-out OOD mechanism family.
The selection objective receives a reference OOD family of collider AND/OR models, then is evaluated on collider XOR; this is within-family mechanism holdout, not open-world generalization.
No ACDB/CausalArena baseline was run; the reported AUC is not comparable to published results on other generators.
When compliance is misspecified, optimizing falsification can amplify zero-support mass; reliability must be modeled or calibrated before applying this objective.

metric_definitions.graph_information_bits: Expected usable reduction in initial one-bit chain/fork graph entropy; zero-support paths receive zero utility credit.
metric_definitions.ood_surprise_auc: Exact weighted ROC AUC ranking held-out XOR trajectories above equal-prior chain/fork trajectories; 0.5 is chance.
metric_definitions.zero_support_mass: In-class probability mass on paths receiving exactly zero probability under learner model.

scenario_definition: Three-node chain/fork candidate family; collider AND/OR reference family; held-out XOR collider mechanism; two adaptive probes; actual compliance 0.5/0.75/1.0; mechanism noise 0.1/0.25.
